Raid Boss Lv. 1 A woman who bargained with the Devil Beleth for power. Thanks to Beleth' teaching, she gained the power of a powerful mystic. Now, she searches for Beleth' historical site supposedly hidden somewhere underground in the south Gludio Wasteland, and prepares a secret ritual to resurrect him.
